theory.title: Adverbs of Frequency
theory.intro: This lesson introduces the language of frequency and habit. The learner now adds a new layer to routine language by indicating how often actions happen.
content: Common adverbs of frequency at this level are always, usually, often, sometimes and never.

theory.title: Building a Learning Plan
theory.intro: The final lesson of Week 7 integrates wants, goals and plans into a short future-oriented learning plan. This is an important step toward more autonomous communication and early A2 behavior.
content: A learning plan connects what you want, what your goal is, and what you plan to do.
At this stage, the learner should use short complete sentences that are personal, clear and realistic.
Useful patterns include I want to..., My goal is to..., and I plan to....
The final output should sound practical and connected to real study and career development.

exercise.question: Write your personal learning direction in English.
exercise.helpText: Use 6 to 8 complete sentences. Include routine, preference, learning style, goal and plan.

teacherNotes.focus: Consolidate the language of the previous weeks in a final personal output that shows coherence, readiness and self-awareness.
tips: Treat this as a milestone lesson.
Require a clear structure: routine, preferences, style, goal, plan.
Keep the output realistic and connected to the student's actual journey.
Prioritize coherence over length.
Use this lesson to measure readiness for the next progression block.
supportPhrases: Show everything you learned together.
Start with your routine.
Now add your preferences and learning style.
Finish with your goal and your plan.
Make your direction clear and personal.

teacherNotes_pt.focus: Consolidar a linguagem das semanas anteriores em uma produção pessoal final que mostre coerência, prontidão e autoconsciência.
tips: Trate esta lição como uma aula-marco.
Exija uma estrutura clara: rotina, preferências, estilo, meta, plano.
Mantenha a produção realista e conectada à jornada do aluno.
Priorize coerência em vez de extensão.
Use esta lição para medir prontidão para o próximo bloco de progressão.
supportPhrases: Mostre tudo o que você aprendeu junto.
Comece com sua rotina.
Agora adicione suas preferências e estilo de aprendizagem.
Termine com sua meta e seu plano.
Torne sua direção clara e pessoal.
